# fjordrun_workflow (Data Source)

A workflow.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "workflow_id" {
  type = string
}

data "fjordrun_workflow" "nightly" {
  id = var.workflow_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Workflow ID.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `definition` (String) The graph, as a JSON document.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether triggers start runs.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID.
- `team_id` (String) Team ID.
- `triggers` (Attributes List) What starts it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--triggers))
- `updated_at` (String) Last change.

<a id="nestedatt--triggers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `triggers`

Read-Only:

- `cron` (String) Cron expression.
- `type` (String) `manual`, `cron`, `webhook` or `api`.
- `webhook_url` (String, Sensitive) URL that starts a run; it contains a secret.
